profile.name: HORIBA SpectrAcq3 光谱采集系统
profile.description: 一套用于实验室光谱测量的光学采集系统，可与单色仪和 CCD 探测器等部件配合使用，完成仪器连接、设备识别与光谱数据采集准备，常用于科研中的光谱分析与测量实验。
profile.description_en: An optical acquisition system for laboratory spectroscopy, used together with components such as monochromators and CCD detectors to support instrument connection, device discovery, and preparation for spectral data acquisition in research measurements.
